images.role: Book & Application Cover
images.title: The Virgin of the Rosary (La Virgen del Rosario)
images.notes: Our Lady seated on a stone bench holding the Christ Child, with both holding a strand of the Holy Rosary. Natural portrait aspect ratio ideal for 6x9 print cover.

images.role: Opening Prayers Spread
images.title: The Holy Trinity (La Trinidad)
images.notes: God the Father holding the Crucified Christ with the Holy Spirit as a dove and surrounding angels. Direct theological visual for the Trinitarian opening formula of the Rosary.

images.role: Closing Prayers Spread
images.title: The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables (Inmaculada de Soult)
images.notes: Our Lady crowned by divine light, standing atop the crescent moon in white and blue drapery, surrounded by jubilant cherubim. Stylistic bookend matching the Murillo cover.

images.role: First Joyful Mystery: The Annunciation
images.title: The Annunciation (La Anunciación)
images.notes: Archangel Gabriel kneeling before the Virgin Mary as the Holy Spirit descends in golden light surrounded by cherubim.

images.role: Second Joyful Mystery: The Visitation
images.title: The Visitation
images.current_location: Princeton University Art Museum, Princeton, New Jersey
images.notes: French Baroque depiction of the Virgin Mary and St. Elizabeth embracing, with St. Joseph and St. Zechariah in the background.

images.role: Third Joyful Mystery: The Nativity
images.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
images.notes: Nocturnal Baroque adoration scene where the newborn Christ Child radiates light onto Mary and the kneeling shepherds, with a choir of angels above.

images.role: Fourth Joyful Mystery: The Presentation in the Temple
images.title: Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
images.notes: Venetian High Renaissance altarpiece depicting Mary presenting the Infant Jesus to Simeon in the Temple.

images.role: Fifth Joyful Mystery: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple
images.title: Christ among the Doctors
images.current_location: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.
images.notes: Northern Renaissance panel showing the twelve-year-old Jesus seated in the center teaching the Doctors of the Law while Mary and Joseph arrive behind Him.

images.role: First Luminous Mystery: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan
images.title: The Baptism of Christ
images.notes: St. John the Baptist pours water over Christ in the River Jordan as angels hold His garments and the Holy Spirit descends from Heaven.

images.role: Second Luminous Mystery: The Wedding at Cana
images.title: The Marriage at Cana
images.current_location: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City, Missouri
images.notes: Vertical Venetian Baroque composition of the wedding banquet at Cana, with a servant holding up a glass of the newly transformed wine above the stone water jars.

images.role: Third Luminous Mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God
images.title: The Sermon on the Mount
images.current_location: Museum of National History, Frederiksborg Castle, Hillerød, Denmark
images.notes: Christ seated on the Galilean hillside proclaiming the Kingdom of God and calling His listeners to conversion.

images.role: Fourth Luminous Mystery: The Transfiguration
images.title: The Transfiguration of Christ
images.current_location: Church of Our Lady (Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk), Bruges, Belgium
images.notes: Northern Renaissance panel showing the transfigured Christ on Mount Tabor flanked by Moses and Elijah in the clouds, with God the Father above and Peter, James, and John below.

images.role: Fifth Luminous Mystery: The Institution of the Eucharist
images.title: The Last Supper
images.notes: Baroque altarpiece depicting Christ bathed in candlelight at the Last Supper, blessing the Eucharistic bread with the chalice before Him.

images.role: First Sorrowful Mystery: The Agony in the Garden
images.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives (Christ's Fear of Death)
images.notes: Caravaggesque tenebrist depiction of Christ kneeling in agony in Gethsemane as a comforting angel leans down from Heaven.

images.role: Second Sorrowful Mystery: The Scourging at the Pillar
images.title: The Flagellation of Christ
images.notes: Painted by Rubens specifically for the Fifteen Mysteries of the Rosary cycle at St. Paul's Church in Antwerp.

images.role: Third Sorrowful Mystery: The Crowning with Thorns
images.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns (La coronación de espinas)
images.notes: Flemish Baroque masterpiece depicting Roman soldiers pressing the crown of thorns onto Christ and offering a reed scepter.

images.role: Fourth Sorrowful Mystery: The Carrying of the Cross
images.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary (Lo Spasimo di Sicilia)
images.medium: Oil on panel transferred to canvas
images.notes: High Renaissance masterpiece showing Christ falling beneath the Cross on the way to Calvary and exchanging a sorrowful gaze with the Blessed Virgin Mary.

images.role: Fifth Sorrowful Mystery: The Crucifixion and Death of Jesus
images.title: Christ on the Cross (Cristo crucificado)
images.notes: Spanish Baroque Crucifixion by Murillo at the Museo del Prado, showing Christ on the Cross illuminated against the dark sky of Golgotha.

images.role: First Glorious Mystery: The Resurrection of Jesus
images.title: The Resurrection of the Lord (La Resurrección del Señor)
images.current_location: Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid, Spain
images.notes: The risen Christ ascends in radiant golden light holding the banner of victory while the Roman guards recoil and sleep around the open tomb below.

images.role: Second Glorious Mystery: The Ascension of Jesus into Heaven
images.title: The Ascension
images.current_location: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, Massachusetts
images.notes: Painted during Copley's study in Rome; Christ ascends in white robes into golden clouds as the Apostles kneel in wonder and two angels point heavenward.

images.role: Third Glorious Mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit (Pentecost)
images.title: Pentecost (Pentecostés)
images.notes: Spanish Baroque altarpiece depicting the Virgin Mary at the center of the Upper Room surrounded by the Apostles and Mary Magdalene as the Holy Spirit and tongues of fire descend.

images.role: Fourth Glorious Mystery: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
images.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
images.notes: The Virgin Mary rises into heavenly golden light in white and royal blue robes, borne aloft by a joyful choir of cherubim.

images.role: Fifth Glorious Mystery: The Coronation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
images.title: The Coronation of the Virgin (La coronación de la Virgen)
images.notes: God the Father and God the Son crown the Virgin Mary with a wreath of roses beneath the radiant dove of the Holy Spirit.
